The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Oblis]] was '''destroyed''' thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==The destruction==
At some point prior to the reign of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Rivan]], a [[Unidentified wandering trader|wandering trader]] transported the [[Darkstaff]], a powerful, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Oblis]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. There, the artifact fell into the hands of the [[Oblee]], the world's native [[Species/Legends|species]], and it was studied by the [[scientist-philosopher]]s, the ruling caste of Oblee. However, the Darkstaff desired to cause destruction wherever it went, and it began to manipulate the Oblee. The artifact used it's powers to summon a [[shadow creature]], a type of energy-based creature from another dimension, to Oblis, and the creature settled into the world's atmosphere. Due to the staff's influence on them, the Oblee came to view the shadow creature as a threat, and the scientist-philosphers determined to use the Darkstaff to power a [[Unidentified Oblis machine|weapon]] that would allow them to remove the shadow creature from the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Recursion" />

The scientist-philosophers created three [[Shard (Oblee)|focusing crystals]] to power their weapon, and the had the entire Oblee species channel their hopes and fears into the [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. They then placed the Darkstaff inside their machine and activated the device. However, when the machine activated, the Darkstaff used the power that it had gained from the crystals to destroy Oblis. The cataclysm hurled the shadow creature out of the Cularin system and transformed the Oblee into incorporal beings known as "shadow lurkers." Over time, the fragments of Oblee eventually settled, to form the [[Cularin asteroid belt]].<ref name="Recursion" />
